checks: Opening an unprepared fixture cannot claim its controller; saved formation and player snapshots are required first.
Selected manager account downloads the real service fixture, explicitly claims recording, and records actual attendance through the shared editor.
A complete eligible staged lineup is saved locally; the independent service read remains unchanged before explicit upload.

The focused match hides team navigation; Back to team and return preserve the running clock without another event. Explicit kickoff and referee pause use the existing confirmation, journal and canonical upload; an independent HTTP read verifies accepted attendance, lineup, time and unchanged score. Fixed score/countdown and action rail stay visible while match details scroll.

An open penalty goal draft retains its selection and original paused capture time while a resumed-clock event is uploaded and its verified snapshot installed; only the later explicit goal confirmation records it.

A second spectator browser sees no locally queued goal, then receives its accepted score automatically without clicking Refresh. This is a functional loopback observation, not a mobile-network p95 benchmark.
